_about: Package deals from the big ski sellers, checked by hand for a group of 4 adults in early March 2027, to compare with our own prices. Not used in the price model: each seller bundles different things (lift pass, or flights and transfers), stays Saturday to Saturday, and prices per person. Prices as shown on the seller's site; GBP not converted.

weski.name: WeSki
weski.incl: Flights from Porto, transfers and the stay. Lift pass extra.

snowtrex.name: SnowTrex
snowtrex.incl: Stay and a 6-day lift pass. No flights.

sunweb.name: Sunweb
sunweb.incl: Stay and a 6-day lift pass. No flights.

deals.title: Cosy Lauzières 415
deals.note: €3,979 for 4 with flights and transfers. Not on our list. Taking off the ~€1,500 WeSki charges for flights and transfers leaves ~€2,480 for the flat; our cheapest 2-bedroom here is €2,647.

deals.title: Silveralp 217 duplex
deals.note: The same flat we list at €3,918 from Booking.com. WeSki's €5,436 for 4 means about €1,500 for flights and transfers; our estimate is about €1,100.

deals.title: Résidence Neves
deals.note: Lift pass in the price. A studio, so our 2-bedroom rule hides places like this.

deals.title: Les Balcons du Soleil
deals.note: Cheapest package in our resorts. SnowTrex sells the same residence at €529 pp.

deals.title: Le Hameau
deals.note: About 100 m from the slopes, indoor pool.

deals.title: Pas de la Casa Princesa
deals.note: The only SnowTrex place in Pas de la Casa.

deals.title: Pierre & Vacances Pas de la Casa Princesa
deals.note: Same residence as SnowTrex, cheaper here.

deals.title: Résidence El Tarter
deals.note: Nothing in Soldeu itself on SnowTrex or Sunweb: our Booking.com list covers Soldeu better.

deals.title: Village Club Miléade
deals.note: Full board and a Portes du Soleil pass. No self-catering in Morzine on Sunweb or SnowTrex for these dates.
